title: Data and code for: Transferring Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9 water-quality retrievals to data-scarce Appalachian coalfield reservoirs
description: Screened satellite-in situ matchup datasets, Google Earth Engine scripts and Python code to reproduce the analyses in Akwemoh et al., 'Transferring Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9 Water-Quality Retrievals to Data-Scarce Appalachian Coalfield Reservoirs: A Withheld-Reservoir Test'. Random forest models for turbidity, Secchi depth, total suspended solids and chlorophyll-a were trained on lakes in seven U.S. states and tested on 12 withheld Eastern Kentucky reservoirs.
